config.script:
connectionName = "SiemensPLC"
	objectId = "nsu=http://agratas.com/UA/;s=F1.A1.SM.MIX3/AGMethods"
	methodId = "nsu=http://agratas.com/UA/;s=F1.A1.SM.MIX3/AGMethods/SetRecipe"
	
	header = {
	    "ProcessStep": "STEP1",
	    "ProductionOrder": "PO12345",
	    "Version": "2.0"
	}
	
	p0 = {
	    "ParameterRef": "Param_001",
	    "ParameterType": "Temperature",
	    "ParameterUOM": "degC",
	    "USL": 60.0,
	    "LSL": 40.0,
	    "Setpoint": 45.0
	}
	
	p1 = {
	    "ParameterRef": "Param_002",
	    "ParameterType": "Speed",
	    "ParameterUOM": "RPM",
	    "USL": 1500.0,
	    "LSL": 500.0,
	    "Setpoint": 1000.0
	}
	
	inputs = [
	    system.util.jsonEncode(header),
	    system.util.jsonEncode([p0, p1])
	]
	
	result = system.opcua.callMethod(
	    connectionName,
	    objectId,
	    methodId,
	    inputs
	)
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger('CallMethodResult')
	logger.info(str(result))
